identity.title: The wonderful complexity of the Mira AB system

paper_type_evidence.quote: We have mapped the $^{12}$CO(3-2) line emission around the Mira AB system at 0.5$''$ resolution using the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA).

question.value: What is the morphology of the circumstellar CO(3-2) gas around the Mira AB binary, and how has it been shaped by the binary interaction?

evidence.quote: We have mapped the CO(3-2) line emission around the system with considerably higher spatial resolution than previous observations ($\sim$0.5$''$).
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2012.1.00524.S .
The observations have four spectral windows with a width of $1.875$ GHz (main array) and $2$ GHz (ACA) centered on 331, 333, 343 and 345 GHz.
We have mapped the $^{12}$CO(3-2) line emission around the Mira AB system

arrays.value: 12m main array (27 and 30 antennas) plus ACA 7m (seven antennas)

evidence.quote: Mira was observed on 25 February 2014 and 3 May 2014, with 27 and 30 of the main array 12m antennas, respectively.
The baseline length of the main array ranges from 13 to 450 m
The images have a beam full width half maximum (FWHM) of 0.576$''$$\times$0.403$''$
we find a maximum recoverable scale (MRS) of $\sim$6$''$. The ACA covers 9 to 45 m baselines and the MRS is $\sim$9$''$.
reach an rms noise of 23 mJy/beam in the emission free channels.
The total time on source is 6.25 minutes with the main array and 6 minutes with the ACA.
It was also observed with seven Atacama Compact Array (ACA) 7m antennas on 8 October 2013.

findings_qualitative.value: Spiral arcs around Mira A are flat and oriented in the orbital plane, with an accretion wake behind the companion

evidence.quote: The spiral appears to be relatively flat and oriented in the orbital plane.

claims.hypothesis: Is the CO gas shaped by binary interaction producing a flat spiral?
claims.result: Spiral arcs seen from 45 to 54 km/s with accretion wake; projected separation 3-5''
claims.finding: Slow AGB wind fills Roche lobe and flows onto companion in orbital plane

evidence.quote: A relatively flat spiral is formed and seen as separate arcs at different velocities.

claims.hypothesis: Does Mira B's wind blow a bubble in Mira A's envelope?
claims.experiment: Blue-wing channel maps and PV diagram, order-of-magnitude timescale
claims.result: ~800 AU bubble, expansion >=5 km/s, timescale ~380 yr
claims.finding: Tentative explanation; timescale somewhat longer than orbital half-period

evidence.quote: We tentatively suggest that this structure is created by the wind of Mira B blowing a bubble in the expanding envelope of Mira A.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Interaction with the ISM cannot explain inner structures, since the bow shock lies much further out

evidence.quote: The presence of the bow shock much further out means that the inner structures cannot be explained by (hydrodynamic) interaction with the ISM.
